title: Skip with continue, stop with break

blocks.text: Inside a loop, `continue` skips the rest of the current pass and moves on to the next one, while `break` ends the loop altogether.
Write `total(int[] readings)` in `Sentinel`. Walk the readings in order and add them up, but:

items: a negative reading is a glitch: skip it and keep going;
a `0` marks the end of the data: stop there, and ignore everything after it.

cases.says: Readings with no glitch and no end mark are all added.
{3, -1, 4} is 7: a negative reading is skipped, not the end.
{3, 4, 0, 10} is 7: nothing after the 0 is added.

concepts: continue skips the rest of one pass, while break ends the whole loop.
